experiment_description: Bright squeezed-vacuum light was generated by high-gain type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion using near-infrared pump pulses from a commercial Yb:YAG femtosecond fiber laser. The pump pulses had wavelength 1030 nm, pulse energy 2 mJ, pulse duration 140 fs, and tunable repetition rate in the range 1 Hz to 10 kHz. A portion of the pump beam was reduced in diameter and sent through two tandem 3-mm-thick BBO crystals separated by approximately 40 cm to select the lowest-divergence spatial mode. A band-pass filter centered at 2050 nm with 100 nm FWHM isolated the degenerate spectral Schmidt mode, producing filtered bright squeezed vacuum centered near 2060 nm with average pulse energy about 0.8 microjoule. More than 10000 single-shot spectra of the filtered field were recorded with a near-infrared spectrometer, and the photon-number distribution was used to calculate the time-domain second-order correlation at zero delay using g2 = <N^2>/<N>^2, where N is the detected photon number in one pulse and angle brackets denote averaging over shots.

filtered_bsv_zero_delay_second_order_cor.description: Measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation of the spectrally filtered, near-single-mode bright squeezed-vacuum driving field.

experiment_description: High-harmonic generation was driven in a 200-micrometer-thick free-standing x-cut lithium niobate crystal using the spectrally filtered bright squeezed-vacuum field generated by type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion in two tandem 3-mm BBO crystals pumped by 1030 nm, 2 mJ, 140 fs Yb:YAG laser pulses. The filtered bright squeezed-vacuum drive was centered near 2060 nm, isolated with a 2050 nm center-wavelength, 100 nm FWHM band-pass filter, and focused by an off-axis parabolic mirror of focal length 25.4 mm into the lithium niobate crystal. The drive intensity at the crystal approached 1.2 TW/cm^2, and the laser polarization was aligned along the lithium niobate Gamma-Z axis. Generated harmonics were collected by a matching off-axis parabolic mirror and recorded shot-by-shot with a Princeton Instruments HRS-500 spectrometer equipped with a PIX-100B high-efficiency detector. Harmonic orders from the second through the tenth were analyzed. For each selected harmonic order, single-shot photon-number distributions were obtained and the zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation was calculated as g2 = <N^2>/<N>^2, where N is the detected photon number in the selected harmonic order and angle brackets denote averaging over laser shots.

fourth_harmonic_zero_delay_second_order_.description: Measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation of the fourth harmonic emitted from lithium niobate under filtered bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

fifth_harmonic_zero_delay_second_order_c.description: Measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation of the fifth harmonic emitted from lithium niobate under filtered bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

eighth_harmonic_zero_delay_second_order_.description: Measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation of the eighth harmonic emitted from lithium niobate under filtered bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

tenth_harmonic_zero_delay_second_order_c.description: Measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation of the tenth harmonic emitted from lithium niobate under filtered bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

harmonic_order_of_maximum_measured_bunch.description: Harmonic order at which the measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation reached its maximum within the analyzed second-through-tenth harmonic range.

experiment_description: Multimode bright squeezed-vacuum light was generated by high-gain type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion using 1030 nm, 2 mJ, 140 fs pulses from a Yb:YAG femtosecond fiber laser with repetition rate tunable from 1 Hz to 10 kHz. The pump beam was sent through two tandem 3-mm-thick BBO crystals separated by approximately 40 cm. No spectral band-pass filter was placed after the BBO crystals, so the output retained several lower-order spectral Schmidt modes, including degenerate and non-degenerate modes. The unfiltered multimode bright squeezed-vacuum field was characterized by recording single-shot spectra with a near-infrared spectrometer and by analyzing the shot-to-shot photon-number distribution. The zero-delay second-order correlation was computed as g2 = <N^2>/<N>^2, where N is the photon number in one pulse and angle brackets denote averaging over shots.

multimode_bsv_zero_delay_second_order_co.description: Measured zero-delay second-order photon-number correlation of the unfiltered multimode bright squeezed-vacuum driving field.

experiment_description: High-harmonic generation was driven in a 200-micrometer-thick free-standing x-cut lithium niobate crystal using unfiltered multimode bright squeezed-vacuum light containing lower-order spectral Schmidt modes and non-degenerate bright entangled photon-pair components. The bright squeezed-vacuum source was produced by type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion in two tandem 3-mm BBO crystals separated by approximately 40 cm and pumped by 1030 nm, 2 mJ, 140 fs Yb:YAG laser pulses. Without spectral filtering, the average single-pulse energy of the multimode field reached about 2 microjoules. The quantum light was focused into the lithium niobate crystal by an off-axis parabolic mirror with focal length 25.4 mm, with polarization aligned along the crystal Gamma-Z axis. Harmonic emission was collected by a matching off-axis parabolic mirror and recorded shot-by-shot using a Princeton Instruments HRS-500 spectrometer with a PIX-100B detector. For the third harmonic, wavelength-resolved single-shot photon-number data over the harmonic spectral range were used to calculate g2(lambda,lambda') = <N(lambda)N(lambda')>/(<N(lambda)><N(lambda')>), where lambda and lambda' are wavelength bins, N(lambda) is the detected photon number in a wavelength bin, and angle brackets denote averaging over shots. The normalized correlation map was calculated as Gamma(lambda,lambda') = [g2(lambda,lambda')]^2/[g2(lambda,lambda)g2(lambda',lambda')].

third_harmonic_wavelength_resolved_g2_pe.description: Number of distinct peaks observed in the wavelength-resolved zero-delay second-order correlation spectrum of the third harmonic under multimode bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

third_harmonic_off_diagonal_spectral_cor.description: Whether the measured wavelength-resolved second-order cross-correlation and normalized correlation maps of the third harmonic showed symmetric off-diagonal correlation lobes between spectrally distinct harmonic components.

experiment_description: Second- and fourth-harmonic emission from a 200-micrometer-thick free-standing x-cut lithium niobate crystal was measured under unfiltered multimode bright squeezed-vacuum driving. The driving field was generated by type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion in two tandem 3-mm-thick BBO crystals pumped by 1030 nm, 2 mJ, 140 fs Yb:YAG laser pulses, with no spectral band-pass filter after the crystals so that non-degenerate bright entangled photon-pair modes remained present. The multimode bright squeezed-vacuum beam was focused into the lithium niobate crystal by a 25.4 mm focal-length off-axis parabolic mirror, with polarization along the Gamma-Z axis. Harmonic spectra were recorded shot-by-shot with a grating spectrometer and CCD detector. For the second harmonic, normalized wavelength-resolved correlation maps Gamma(lambda,lambda') were evaluated over approximately 950 to 1100 nm; for the fourth harmonic, the same analysis was performed over approximately 450 to 550 nm. Here lambda and lambda' are harmonic wavelength bins, Gamma(lambda,lambda') = [g2(lambda,lambda')]^2/[g2(lambda,lambda)g2(lambda',lambda')], and g2(lambda,lambda') = <N(lambda)N(lambda')>/(<N(lambda)><N(lambda')>).

second_harmonic_off_diagonal_normalized_.description: Whether the measured normalized wavelength-resolved correlation map of the second harmonic exhibited pronounced off-diagonal correlations under multimode bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

fourth_harmonic_off_diagonal_normalized_.description: Whether the measured normalized wavelength-resolved correlation map of the fourth harmonic exhibited off-diagonal correlations under multimode bright squeezed-vacuum driving.

maximum_harmonic_order_with_detectable_b.description: Highest harmonic order for which bright entangled photon-pair contributions were reported as detectable in the multimode bright squeezed-vacuum-driven harmonic emission.
